name: hackforge
description: Hackathon harness: research a theme with live web data (Bright Data, GitHub, HN, papers), run an idea tournament scored against the event rubric, build demo-first with a separate QA judge, and ship a judge-ready submission — with a deadline clock and guardrails.

hook_profile.title: Hook profile
hook_profile.description: off = no guardrails; fast = ask on risky git/judge-file edits (default); safe = deny them and ask on code edits after feature freeze.
